next_steps: Point a small budget at the pages you already have

Publish info@origianpower.com - you already own the domain. A Gmail address on a solar EPC site reads smaller than the service list next to it.
Offer WhatsApp alongside the form, or drop the reCAPTCHA step, so a paid click reaches you in one tap.
Your location pages are in English only. Telugu creative is the language of the Telangana homeowner your competitors are buying.

site_audit.platform: WordPress 6.9.11, Elementor 4.3.6, Slider Revolution 6.7.34 (sr7-module), greenly theme, Yoast SEO Premium 26.3 with a full schema graph, locally-hosted Google Fonts
site_audit.html_errors: 7 errors, 3 warnings and 87 info messages on the homepage. The errors are four stray </br> end tags, an 'image_lists' unknown element inside the Slider Revolution module, an <h4> that follows an <h2> with no <h3> between them, two <section> elements and one <article> with no accessible heading. The served HTML also ships the three service cards (Solar on-grid power plants, Solar off-grid power plants, Solar water heating systems) twice, and the page closes with the stray text 'BESbswy' - Slider Revolution's own demo signature.
site_audit.scope_note: The complete <head> was read - source lines 1 to 182, ending at the favicon and preconnect links - and it carries no tracking tag of any kind, so all eight tracking rows are measured in both directions and every zero is a measurement. The rows that still read 'Not checked' are the ones the checker does not report and the source did not carry in readable form: the meta description length, the h1 count, the favicon, the CTA count, the image alt-text counts and the sitemap.

issues: Your 3 live Google ads are booked under the personal name REDDYMASI SOHITH, not Origian Power - the verified advertiser record shows an individual, so the brand you are buying for is invisible in the transparency record.

There is no tracking of any kind on the site: no Meta Pixel, no GA4, no GTM, no Google Ads tag and no LinkedIn, Clarity or Hotjar was read in the complete head. You are paying for clicks with nothing on the page counting them.

Your own page repeats itself: the three service cards - Solar on-grid power plants, Solar off-grid power plants, Solar water heating systems - appear twice in the served HTML, and the checker reports 4 stray </br> end tags, 2 sections and 1 article with no accessible heading, and an <h4> following an <h2>.

All three testimonials are from Anantapur and Nandyal in Andhra Pradesh - Mr Ravi (5 kW, Nandyal), Mr Damodar Reddy (2 x 5 kW, Anantapur), Mr Sharath (10 kW, Anantapur) - on a page whose hero says Hyderabad and whose Google ads buy Hyderabad traffic.

The only published contact routes are a Gmail address (origian.ei@gmail.com) and one phone line, and the page closes with the stray text 'BESbswy' before the footer - Slider Revolution's demo signature, left in production.
No Meta Pixel installed — can't run retargeting or track ad conversions
No Google Ads / GTM tracking — can't measure ad performance
No Google Analytics — flying blind on website traffic
No WhatsApp link — losing mobile leads (WhatsApp converts 3x better for Indian home services)
No live chat — missing after-hours leads

promise_gap: Google Ads Transparency: 3 live ads under advertiser AR00071167135648317441, verified as REDDYMASI SOHITH - one YouTube video creative (DTApvXLQPMQ) and two Display image creatives.

The advertiser of record is a person, not the company. A prospect who checks the transparency record sees a name that does not match the brand, and the page those ads land on has no tracking that could tell either of you what the spend produced.
The homepage promises 'Cut electricity bills by 70-95%', 'Get PM Suryaghar subsidy for residential rooftop systems', 'Increase home value' and 'reliable backup power with off-grid systems'.

The PM Suryaghar subsidy section is present and the service descriptions are specific. But the three proofs on the page are all Anantapur-district installations, the three service cards are shipped twice in the HTML, and the page's own article:modified_time is 2025-12-17 - the site has not been touched in eleven months while the ads run.
The site presents solar on-grid power plants, solar off-grid power plants and solar water heating systems as three service lines, with a projects gallery and three named testimonials.

The gallery and the testimonials are real, and the contact section carries a working tel: link and a WPForms form with reCAPTCHA. What is missing is any measurement at all: no pixel, no GA4, no tag manager, so nobody can say whether the twelve pages of content have ever produced an enquiry.
